business_summary: Ladderup Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in investing in securities of listed and unlisted companies in India. It operates through Investment & Trading in Shares & Securities, and Finance Activities segments. The company offers one-stop financial advisory and fund-raising solutions in investment banking, capital markets, wealth management, project finance, and growth stage investing. It provides venture capital; debt/structured finance products; and special situation advisory services. In addition, the company offers wealth management advisory, such as mutual funds, insurance, bonds, structured products, and portfolio management solutions to HNIs, corporates, family offices, and individuals. The company serves financial services, healthcare, retail, packaging, quick service restaurants, information technology, infrastructure, energy, oil and gas, and real estate sectors. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Mumbai, India.
